description: Checks one VAT number against the European Commission's VIES service and returns whether it is a live registration and, where the member state shares it, the registered name. Covers the 27 EU states and Northern Ireland (XI). A busy or down member state is reported as an error, never as an invalid number.

vat.description: VAT number starting with its two-letter country code. Spaces, dots and hyphens are ignored; GR is read as EL.

name: validate_vat
title: Validate an EU VAT number
